sar.narrative: This report details suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C13171 and card C13171-K2. On December 19, 2016, the customer reported a $55.68 online transaction as unrecognized. A review of the account identified a total of six suspicious online transactions between December 13 and December 22, 2016, totaling $158.32. Four of these transactions occurred in a cluster on December 19 under a newly created holder profile. The flagged transaction and two others were conducted using device D008431 (profile: unknown | unknown | chrome 66.0 | unknown). Notably, the device was observed routing transactions through an anonymous IP proxy on December 13 and December 22. The card itself has a history of severe compromise, with 18 prior confirmed fraud cases. Furthermore, device D008431 is shared across 126 cards with a high lift for suspicious activity, indicating a broader pattern of abuse. The combination of the customer's direct dispute, the use of an anonymizing proxy, and the device's association with broader suspicious activity confirms the fraudulent nature of these transactions.

stop_reason: The investigation stopped because the direct customer report combined with independent evidence of proxy usage and a severe history of card compromise provides decisive proof of fraud, satisfying policy section 6.
